subject: Parallax Paraphrase API: sudden latency & accuracy regression after model upgrade
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@parallax.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Parallax Platform Ops <platform-ops@parallax.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.1-q2 rollout

Marcus —

We pushed your recommended v3.1-q2 quant profile last night (auto rollout window 02:00 UTC). Since 07:30 UTC we’re seeing a sharp p99 latency jump and a spike in hallucination/incorrect-paraphrase rates on our paraphrase endpoint. Quick numbers from our side (attached CSV):
- p50: +20ms (small)
- p95: +140ms
- p99: from ~320ms to ~1.9s
- throughput: ~35% drop in tokens/sec under typical load
- client error 502s increased from 0.2% to 3.8%
- downstream quality eval (BLEU-like) drop: ~9pts for short-form paraphrases

We need an immediate mitigation. Can you revert us to the previous profile or give an ETA for a hotfix? Our SLAs are tight and customer support is fielding irate callers. We attached the ops metrics and a short log excerpt.

Attachments: parallax_ops_metrics_qprofile.csv, svc_dump_20280618.log

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Head of Platform — Parallax Systems
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@parallax.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.1-q2 rollout

Alyssa — thanks for the quick data. We see the same signal in our dashboards. I’m looping in SRE and CS to coordinate. Immediate plan:
1) I’ll authorize a temporary routing change to pin Parallax to v3.0 (pre-quant) while SRE triages.
2) Evelyn — please prioritize an emergency check of the quant kernel selection & KV-cache sizing for Parallax’s model variant (v3.1-q2).
3) Grace/Karthik — can you draft an outward-facing status note for Parallax customers and confirm whether Parallax wants a credit while we resolve?

Alyssa, I’ll confirm the rollback window in the next 10–15 minutes.

— Marcus
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@parallax.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.1-q2 rollout

Alyssa — I’m on standby to craft a short customer-facing note and will coordinate support routing. Short asks for Parallax:
- Confirm whether you want an immediate auto-rollback to v3.0 or prefer we apply a hotfix (Evelyn will advise on risk/time).
- If rollback, we can do a fast pin (no code changes) and target 5–10min for traffic cutover; there will be a brief 1–2s blip per connection during session reassignments.

Karthik will track the credit request and author a credit proposal once we know duration of impact.

Grace
Director, Customer Success
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production regression after v3.1-q2 rollout — preliminary triage

Quick triage notes (prelim):
- Observed same p99 jump and throughput drop in our infra traces for Parallax tenant IDs.
- Root suspicion: the v3.1-q2 profile switches to an aggressive 8-bit quant kernel that changes GEMM tiling and KV-cache layout for this model (longer average context and many small requests). On their workload the kernel fails to utilize the fast attention path for short sequences, falling back to a slower path.
- We also see increased memory churn and frequent small GC events on the host which correlate with the 502 spikes.

Options:
A) Immediate revert to v3.0 model variant + disable q2 profile for Parallax (fastest, low-risk). Estimated time: ~10 minutes to flip, immediate traffic improvement expected.
B) Hotfix: tune kernel selection thresholds and adjust KV cache allocation to favor short-context paths for this tenant. Estimated time: ~90–120 minutes with a staged rollout to validate. Some risk of transient errors during kernel swap.

I recommend Option A now (rollback) and Option B as a medium-term fix to keep the q-profile available once we tune. I’ll attach a short log excerpt and the critical trace spans.

Attachments: post_rollforward_p99_snapshot.png

— Evelyn
SRE Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@parallax.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@parallax.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Executive update: Parallax production impact — decision point on rollback vs hotfix

Samir / Alyssa — we’ve identified the likely cause and proposed two remediation options (revert to v3.0 now or apply a hotfix to q2). Evelyn recommends a revert for immediate mitigation; hotfix is the follow-up.

Requesting exec decision: do you want us to perform the immediate revert (fastest path) or hold traffic while we attempt the hotfix? If you choose revert, we will also prepare a postmortem and propose a goodwill credit for the impacted window. If you prefer hotfix, we will need a 90–120 minute maintenance window and will provide staged validation checkpoints.

I can set up a 30-minute escalation call with our CTO and SRE lead if you want to talk through details now. Please advise.

— Marcus
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@parallax.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@parallax.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Resolution: rollback complete + follow-up actions

Alyssa / Samir — update: we executed the emergency rollback for Parallax at 2028-06-19T16:10:00-07:00 and pinned traffic to v3.0. Immediate post-rollback metrics (attached):
- p99 back down to ~330ms
- throughput recovered to baseline within ~7 minutes
- 502 rate returned to 0.3%
- quality metrics restored to expected range (BLEU-like delta <1pt)

Next steps:
- Evelyn’s team will run the kernel selection analysis and produce a remediation patch for the q2 profile; target for lab validation is 2028-06-21 EOD.
- We’ll schedule a joint postmortem with Parallax on 2028-06-22 to walk through root cause and mitigations.
- Grace/Karthik will share a proposed goodwill credit for the impacted hours by noon tomorrow.

Attachments: final_postrollback_metrics.csv

Thank you for the rapid coordination. We’ll keep you posted and circulate the postmortem draft.

— Marcus Lin
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
